basis: User 2026-08-03 instruction: E3 with multiple models (Qwen + GLM). W7 support rule admitted feedback and interaction (manipulation check + downstream both passed); memory and planning did not qualify.
access: all three models through the same Packy proxy; claim is same-proxy model-family sensitivity, not provider independence

design.deepseek_rerun: DeepSeek reruns on the same new paired seeds; no old-seed comparisons
design.metrics: v8 frozen summarizer; model-internal paired effect and same-seed cross-model difference

stop_rule: Each model lane stops on its first exception or non-three-for-three-VALID batch; any failure stops all new paid jobs pending an audited recovery amendment.
claim_boundary: Limited confirmation of positive findings only; not complete model robustness, not provider independence, not empirical validation.
